summary: The Interim General Manager, Economic Development and Culture, and the Policy Development Officer, Economic Development and Culture, will provide an update on the City of Toronto's Recognition Review project, including next steps for the renaming of Dundas Street.
decided: The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Interim General Manager, Economic Development and Culture, to incorporate the Committee's feedback into its work on the recognition review and renaming of Dundas Street. 2. Requested the Interim General Manager, Economic Development and Culture, to request the Community Advisory Committee on Renaming Dundas Street, once formed, to consider the name "Diversity Street" as a name to replace Dundas Street.
